_comment: Gallery images for the GREAT Greenland ROV site. To add a photo: commit the image file into this images/ folder, then add an entry to the list below. The gallery on the homepage renders these in order.

photos.caption: The team monitoring a dive from the ROV control cabin.
Live camera and sonar feeds from Étaín on the seabed. The green lasers give scale.
Operating the manipulators to collect a core sample.
Flying Étaín from OceanRINGS autopilot control software.
The team following the dive from the control container.
Pre-dive planning from the multibeam before the volcano dive.
A deep-sea anemone spreads its tentacles on the seabed, crossed by the green scaling lasers.
An anemone perched on cold-water coral and sponges, lit by the ROV.
A soft coral colony rising from the seabed in the ROV's lights.
Multibeam sonar and the HD14K camera feed on the control-room screen during a dive.
Crew watching the multibeam sonar and live camera feeds from the control container.
